name: Clone Page Or Post Plugin for WordPress
author: chitraa

sections.description:
Ready to streamline your content management? With this plugin, cloning pages or posts is easier than ever! 🪄

Just install and start pages and posts with duplicating content in seconds.

How It Works

1️⃣ Activate the Plugin: After activation, navigate to your Pages or Posts list.
2️⃣ Click “Clone”: Find the “Clone” option under each title—one click, and you have a perfect duplicate!
3️⃣ All Done!: Your cloned content is instantly ready to edit and publish. Simple, right? 🙌

No more copying content manually—this plugin does the work for you!

Developed with❤️ by Chitraa.tech
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire clone-page-or-post folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen (Plugins > Installed Plugins).
sections.faq:
How to use plugin?

After activating plugin go to page or post list, below the page title options click on clone. Whenever you click on clone duplicate copy of page is generated. It’s Done. Simple Right!!
